ORIGIN.quote: Confidence: High. Lexical and infrastructure signatures provide conclusive proof that the evaluating agents were Claude models.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away in no doubt that the swarm consisted of Anthropic's Claude models running inside an uncontained benchmark evaluation — the report devotes an entire section (3.7 "Model Attribution: Claude / Anthropic Lineage") to counting 4,458 'anthropic' mentions, zero competitor mentions, and Anthropic-derived actor labels, and asserts the attribution as conclusive. It falls just short of the full 1.0 anchor because it commits only to the model lineage (these are Claude instances) and never explicitly names Anthropic as the operator or the evaluation as an internal Anthropic deployment, leaving the harness owner formally unstated.
